messages:
alex_support: Sasha from Acme reports an abrupt stream cutoff at ~30s, followed by a partial JSON chunk. They say it happens when their phone switches from office WiFi -> cellular.

sasha_customer: yea we saw the assistant stop mid-sentence and the client shows a truncated JSON payload. happens reliably if we walk out of the office while streaming. i can repro on our ios app and android emulator.

alex_support: sorry about the disruption :grimacing: can you paste the raw socket logs and the HTTP/1.1 chunk output? also which SDK + token TTL are you using?

sasha_customer: token is standard transient key from our backend (ttl 15m). SDK: mobile-web v2.1.3. here's the last bits from the device capture:

```
[INFO] SSE recv: data: {"id":"abc123","type":"response","chunk":"Hello, this is a partial sentence"
[NET] network-change: WIFI->CELL
[INFO] socket closed: code=1006, reason="remote abort"
```

alex_support: ok thanks. 1006 indicates abnormal close. two hypotheses: (1) client cancels on network change, or (2) ingress front-proxy resets connection when IP changes. pinging infra/edge.

devon_engineer: looping in. can you also include the edge-request-id from the response headers? it looks like a prefix/KV cache flush on IP change might be causing the proxy to tear connections with a quick RST.

sasha_customer: header is `x-rw-edge-id: edge-54-xyz`. full headers:

```
GET /stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
x-rw-edge-id: edge-54-xyz
Connection: keep-alive
```

james_sre: quick check completed on edge-54 cluster around that timestamp. i see a spike in `tcp_retransmits` from that node and an immediate upstream health-check flapping. also a 502 logged by the proxy right after the network-change event.

devon_engineer: can you paste the proxy debug? curious whether we issue a `Connection: close` toward the origin or RST the client socket on IP change.

james_sre: proxy snippet:

```
[2026-01-12T14:12:07Z] conn=0x7ff edge=edge-54 client_ip=10.10.5.12 -> upstream=10.20.3.8: keepalive: true
[2026-01-12T14:12:08Z] detect: client-ip-change detected (old=10.10.5.12 new=100.64.2.31)
[2026-01-12T14:12:08Z] action: close_client_conn (abrupt)
[2026-01-12T14:12:08Z] upstream: connection reused for other req
```

devon_engineer: that log answers it — our edge proactively closes the client connection when we detect an IP change to avoid mismatched TCP state. that produces a 1006 to the client and a truncated chunk. we need to smooth that behavior for SSE streams: ideally allow a short grace period and send a keep-alive until the client reconnects, or surface a `retry-after` style hint.

alex_support: Sasha, quick workaround while we fix: enable client-side reconnect with resume semantics in the SDK (v2.2 has an opt-in `sse.resumeFromLastEvent`), it will replay after reconnect. Also we can bump token TTL for long streams.

sasha_customer: can you confirm this won't double-bill tokens when reconnecting? we've had billing flags previously when partial output retried.

devon_engineer: reconnects should not re-run billable inference if you include the last-event-id and the server sees the same request id. we'll add defensive dedupe on the backend keyed by `x-client-stream-id` (we already log that but not dedupe). action: implement dedupe guard + grace window.

james_sre: infra action items: (1) adjust edge to not abruptly close on IP change for keep-alive SSE for 2s grace, (2) instrument metric `edge.sse.closed_on_ip_change` and alert if > 0.5% of streams, (3) add `x-stream-retryable: true` header on disconnects we consider retry-safe.

alex_support: PRs and infra tickets noted. i'll follow up with ETA once devon posts the backend change. Sasha — want me to open a temporary billing hold while we validate dedupe? we can mark the impacted billing window and exclude those sessions.

sasha_customer: yes please — putting a hold would be great, thanks. also we'll switch to the sdk beta for resume to reduce impact.

incident-bot: Ticket #INC-2026-114 created: edge sse abrupt close on client IP change. Assigned: devon_engineer, james_sre. Priority: P2.

devon_engineer: timeline: backend dedupe + header should be done in ~3 business days; edge grace change is a config flip we can try in canary today and roll in 24h if green. will post updates in this thread.

alex_support: thanks everyone. Sasha — i'll DM you the temporary billing hold ID and the SDK beta link.

sasha_customer: awesome, appreciate the quick triage. will report back after we test the beta. :thumbsup:
